extraction_notes: MM1Z18 electrical-characteristics row: VZ minimum 16.8 V, nominal 18 V, maximum 19.1 V; IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 40 ohm at IZT; maximum IR = 0.1 uA at VR = 13 V; Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
The schema has no nominal source_kind, so the nominal VZ and its IZT test current are represented as typical while the min/max VZ values are retained in this note.
Maximum ratings also publish PD = 500 mW, VF maximum 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, Tj and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and typical RthetaJ-A = 340 degC/W.
The MM1Z18 curve points were digitized from the labeled 18 curve in Fig. 2; the plotted axes are VZ in V and IZ in mA, converted here to SI amperes for the y values.
No diode capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published in the supplied datasheet; those schema fields are null.
